relay.members_of:
SELECT chat_id, member, role, added_by, joined_at, settings, muted, silenced, silenced_until FROM people_members WHERE chat_id = ?1 AND left_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY joined_at, CASE WHEN member LIKE 'user:%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, member
relay.chats_of_member:
SELECT p.id, p.kind, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.title, p.image_key, p.avatar_leaf, p.avatar_leaf_color, p.description FROM people_chats p
                 JOIN people_members m ON m.chat_id = p.id
                 WHERE m.member = ?1 AND m.left_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

queries.relay_unread:
SELECT e.chat_id, e.project_id, COUNT(*) FROM chat_events e
         WHERE e.id > COALESCE((SELECT r.event_id FROM chat_user_reads r WHERE r.user_id = ?1 AND r.chat_id = e.chat_id), 0)
           AND (e.sender_user IS NULL OR e.sender_user != ?1)
           AND (e.sender_user IS NULL OR e.sender_user NOT IN (SELECT blocked FROM blocks WHERE blocker = ?1))
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_user_archive a WHERE a.user_id = ?1 AND a.chat_id = e.chat_id)
           AND (
             e.chat_id IN (SELECT chat_id FROM people_members WHERE member = ?2 AND left_at IS NULL)
             OR e.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = ?1)
             OR e.project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM project_members WHERE user_id = ?1 AND left_at IS NULL)
           )
         GROUP BY e.chat_id ORDER BY MAX(e.id) DESC
queries.box_fts:
SELECT t.id, t.thread_id, t.subagent_id, t.session_id, t.kind, t.role, t.at, t.text, t.size, bm25(t3_fts) AS score,
                        snippet(t3_fts, 0, '[', ']', '…', 24)
                 FROM t3_fts JOIN t3 t ON t.id = t3_fts.id
                 WHERE t3_fts MATCH ?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR t.thread_id = ?2)
                   AND (?3 IS NULL OR t.kind = ?3 OR (?3 = 'user' AND t.kind = ?6))
                 ORDER BY score LIMIT ?4 OFFSET ?5
queries.box_job_for_worker: SELECT id, chat_id, ask_message_id, subagent_id, title, kind, brief, touches, state, last_step, last_step_at, created_at, started_at, ended_at, error, delivered_key, restarts, steers FROM jobs WHERE subagent_id = ?1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
queries.box_open_jobs: SELECT id, chat_id, ask_message_id, subagent_id, title, kind, brief, touches, state, last_step, last_step_at, created_at, started_at, ended_at, error, delivered_key, restarts, steers FROM jobs WHERE state IN ('queued','running') ORDER BY created_at ASC
